title: Azure Workspaces
subtitle: How a KPMG engagement boundary is built, where the data lives, and how agents work inside it.

scenes.narration: Azure Workspaces. How a KPMG engagement boundary is built, where the data lives, and how agents work inside it. About three minutes.

beats.text: Azure Workspaces
How a KPMG engagement boundary is built — and how agents work inside it.
~3 minutes

scenes.narration: It starts with a Tenant. A Microsoft Entra ID tenant is your organization's identity boundary — one directory of users, groups, and trust.

scenes.narration: Inside the tenant, a subscription is a billing and access container. This tenant holds three: GAC, Germany, and Digital Gateway. Everything in this walkthrough is built inside the Digital Gateway subscription — the other two sit alongside it, governed the same way.

beats.text: Inside the tenant: Subscriptions.
Three of them — GAC, Germany, and Digital Gateway.
We build inside Digital Gateway. The rest sit alongside it.

Virtual Machines, SQL Databases, Containers, Storage...
...App Services, Virtual Networks, Key Vaults, Functions — and more.
Each one is a resource.

scenes.narration: Outside the workspace sit the shelves. A shelf holds reusable, pre-approved assets — gold copies. There's a Velocity shelf and a US Specific shelf. When an engagement needs an asset, a gold copy is lifted off the shelf and placed inside the workspace boundary. The shelf stays outside; only a copy crosses the wall.

beats.text: Outside the workspace: Shelves.
Shelves hold reusable, pre-approved gold copies.
A Velocity shelf and a US Specific shelf.
A gold copy is lifted off the shelf — into the workspace.

scenes.narration: How does anything get in? Through the client portal. It's the single, governed doorway between the client and a workspace. Every upload is authenticated, scoped to one engagement, and logged. Nothing reaches the workspace except through the portal.

beats.text: How does data get in? The Client Portal.
One governed doorway: authenticated, scoped, logged.
Nothing enters the workspace except through the portal.

scenes.caption: The client portal is the only governed way data enters a workspace

scenes.narration: In the real world, data starts in the client's own environment. It crosses into the client portal — the controlled doorway — and only then lands inside the workspace, running in the East US data center in Virginia. Real systems, a real building, real distance.

beats.text: Data starts in the client's world.
It enters through the client portal — the controlled doorway.
...and lands inside the Workspace, in the East US data center.
Real systems, a real place on the map.
